about: One registry of every cut puppet part in the suite (lane A). Coordinates are px in the part file; pivot is the brad the part turns on; sockets are where children pin; scale.px_per_cm turns px into cm. paint: painted (a painting of this character), composited (recoloured/pasted from other paintings by generate_v2_kits.py) or coded (drawn by a program). Written by shots/suite/tools/build_parts.py; see shots/suite/AUDIT_parts.md.
schema: id, character, costume, part, side, view, state, file, w, h, pivot, parent_part, sockets, scale{px_per_cm,source}, height_cm_real (part file height in cm), char_height_cm, sheet, provenance, painted, paint, category, poems, label_method, pivot_source, brads
